purpose: silver_nyc_weather is the cleaned, typed hourly weather observation table for the three New York airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) covering January through June 2013, derived one-to-one from bronze.nyc_weather's 13014 rows. It feeds flight-delay and operations analytics that join weather conditions to departures by airport and hour.
usage: Read one row per origin airport per time_hour; time_hour is a true TIMESTAMP in UTC and year, month, day and hour are its integer components kept for convenient filtering and grouping. Measurement columns are DECIMAL and may be null where the sensor did not report: wind_gust is null for about 75 percent of rows (null_rate 0.745505) and pressure for about 11 percent (null_rate 0.114953), so consumers must handle nulls deliberately rather than treating them as zero.
limitations: No imputation, row filtering, or unit conversion was applied; nulls are retained as landed. One implausible wind_speed value (max 1048.36058, against typical readings under 25) survives cleanup and should be screened by consumers or addressed by an upstream quality rule. The three Airbyte capture columns are excluded, so lineage back to the raw record id is only available in bronze, and the declared grain of origin plus time_hour (13014 rows against 3 x 4341 = 13023 possible combinations) still needs confirmation against the warehouse before approval.
